intro: Ancestral voices, field recordings and electronic bass.
healing_text: There is a quieter side of me as NAOBA: sound as medicine. I go into the forest, the river, the ocean, and listen for their deepest resonances. From those recordings I make slow ambient journeys for meditation and rest, shaped by what I study in psychoacoustics, how our body and brain answer to sound, and in bioacoustics, the voices of living ecosystems. Close your eyes, breathe, and let the Earth tune you back.
